semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides advanced filtration solutions critical for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: International Green Technology Japan develops advanced filtration solutions, including the SolaCielTM chemical filter, to enhance air purity in semiconductor cleanrooms.
